intro: Iraq is a federal parliamentary republic, with power shared between its main communities.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Parliament elects the president, who asks the largest bloc to form a government led by a prime minister. By custom, the prime minister is a Shia Arab, the president a Kurd and the speaker a Sunni Arab.
The Kurdistan Region in the north has its own government, parliament and security forces.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: Armed groups, corruption and power cuts have caused anger; big protests broke out in 2019.

keyTerms.meaning: Power shared between national and regional governments.
